title: A middle-aged man, agonizing from the morning.｜日常のようへい

blocks.x: The morning I arrived in Nagoya.I was at 'Piyorin Village' in Nagoya Station from 7:30 in the morning.And what's more, I was a middle-aged man all by myself.A colleague at work had recommended it to me before.'Piyorin is great.'The one who recommended it was, surprisingly, also a middle-aged man
